title: Ledger Accounting Note: From When Interest Runs on Whole Life Insurance Accumulations Withdrawn at an Election
content:
Interest on accumulations withdrawn at a reduced paid-up election of an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy runs on the balance shown on the policy from a start date that the ledger fixes:

1. where an accumulation withdrawal is dated after the most recent policy anniversary, from the date of the latest such withdrawal;
2. where no withdrawal is dated after the anniversary but a dividend deposit entry is, from the date of the latest such deposit;
3. otherwise, from the most recent policy anniversary.

The most recent policy anniversary is the anniversary the posted cash values are as of. Interest runs to the date the election takes effect.

## Ledger cases (hypothetical, most recent anniversary March 1, 2025)

| Accumulation withdrawals after March 1, 2025 | Dividend deposit entries after March 1, 2025 | Interest runs from |
|---|---|---|
| April 20, 2025 and June 2, 2025 | May 5, 2025 | June 2, 2025 |
| None | May 5, 2025 | May 5, 2025 |
| None | None (the anniversary deposit is dated March 1, 2025, not after it) | March 1, 2025 |
| July 7, 2025 | None | July 7, 2025 |
